msg: Hello! We are a couple from South Korea. We both have Open Water license. We want to do the 2 dives trip from Cartagena. Is transfer from airport included?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The airport transfer isn’t included. For the 2-dive trip from Cartagena, you’ll meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; getting to the dock is on your own. The trip does include the speedboat transfer between Cartagena and the Rosario Islands, both dives, equipment, lunch, park entrance, dive insurance, and the DIVE TO HEAL contribution.

Would you like the price and booking link for the trip?

msg: Yes please. We want to go on December 12, two people.
reply:
🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

⚠️ If anyone hasn't dived for *more than 2 years*, a *refresher* is added (the mini-course: pool and one dive with an instructor): *183 USD* per person. Is that your case?
